title: Capability
description: A yes/no/partial fact about an engine (feature, behaviour, limitation), with version ranges and optional automated probes.

support.description: Per engine: list of versioned statements. Engines not listed are 'unknown'.

probes.description: Executable checks. A probe succeeds when all statements run without error and 'check' (if given) returns a truthy first column. Success is expected for supported/partial, failure for unsupported.

result_sets.description: Minimum number of result sets the last statement must return (e.g. SELECT ... FACET).

rows.description: Exact number of rows the first result set of the last statement must return (for engines where 'check' cannot count, e.g. no derived tables).

invert.description: The capability shows as an error: the probe succeeds when the statements FAIL (e.g. a CHECK constraint rejecting a row). Setup must still succeed.
